keyword: when does march madness bracket come out
claims: The 2026 March Madness men’s and women’s tournament brackets were released on Selection Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 2026 March Madness men's bracket was unveiled at 6 p.m. ET on CBS.
The 2026 March Madness women's bracket was revealed on ESPN at 8 p.m. ET.
The 2026 March Madness First Four begins on Tuesday, March 17, 2026.
Selection Sunday for 2026 March Madness is March 15, 2026.
First Four for 2026 March Madness is March 17–18, 2026.
First Round for 2026 March Madness is March 19–20, 2026.
Final Four for 2026 March Madness is April 4 and 6, 2026 in Indianapolis.
2026 March Madness first round games tip off on March 19, 2026.
